title: MAX and MIN coerce direct text and logicals and read omitted direct args as 0, while skipping them inside arrays/ranges
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527.20088, MAX and MIN coerce direct arguments to numbers (reading "2" as 2, TRUE as 1, non-numeric text as #VALUE!, and omitted direct arguments as 0 so MIN(1,) = 0 and MAX(-1,) = 0), whereas inside arrays and cell references they skip text, logicals, and blanks and return 0 when no numeric value is present (MIN({TRUE,"1"}) = 0).
basis: Measured across cfunc_m3_4 readings in Excel 16.0.20527.20088 (argument_classes rows 75-87) and matched across 1,211/1,211 MAX and 1,212/1,212 MIN full-bank rows plus 120/120 pinned rows each.
